name: tcl-beyondtv2
description: TCL BeyondTV2 (Android TV 11, firmware AR05, 2 GB RAM). Tested end to end by the author on a real device.

packages_disable.why: Alexa voice service, about 18 MB of RAM. Skip it if you use Alexa.
Miracast screen-mirroring receiver, about 6 MB. Google Cast is separate.
Secure Element service. A TV has no NFC chip for it to serve, about 10 MB.
Auto-pairs the TCL Bluetooth remote. Only disable it if you do not use that remote.
Serves the Android TV Remote phone app. Only disable it if you do not use the phone remote.

background_restrict.why: Stops Netflix starting itself at power-on. It still opens normally.
Stops Prime Video starting itself at power-on.
Stops JioHotstar starting itself at power-on.
Stops YouTube and its recommendations starting itself.
Stops Google Play Movies starting itself at power-on.
Stops Google Play Games starting itself at power-on.
TCL's phone-to-TV interaction service; it restarts at power-on.

jobs_cancel.why: YouTube's recommendations job. It comes back if you open YouTube again.

settings.why: Half-length window animations, so menus feel quicker.

dns.why: Encrypted DNS that blocks ads and trackers for the whole TV. Needs TCP 853 open on your router. Undo if apps stop loading.

notes: The 'safe' group only disables apps you do not need to watch TV, and only background-starts the streaming apps.
TCL's own service apps (TGuard, the TV input, the key service) are not listed. Removing them breaks TCL features.
